title: Generate a full conditional pair jointly using forward code rather than a supplied-witness inverse
statement: For h(0,z)=z,h(1,z)=P(z), draw U uniform and independent fair B,B prime and output(0,P(U)) or(1,U) by each tag. This is the exact full-fibre native product pair with one forward call. More generally verified permutations P_j,R_j,Q with P_j R_j=Q give an exact shared-seed joint cover; certified alignment epsilon gives TV<=2epsilon and exact native marginals, with accepted-good semantic allowance eta+2epsilon charged ONCE for the full old tuple.

requires: Actual branch permutation/forward code and exact uniform native seed/tag access; checked common-forward words or paid alignment with the separate permutation premise. Actual source equality/guard timing for semantic reuse.
provides: For h(0,z)=z,h(1,z)=P(z), draw U uniform and independent fair B,B prime and output(0,P(U)) or(1,U) by each tag. This is the exact full-fibre native product pair with one forward call. More generally verified permutations P_j,R_j,Q with P_j R_j=Q give an exact shared-seed joint cover; certified alignment epsilon gives TV<=2epsilon and exact native marginals, with accepted-good semantic allowance eta+2epsilon charged ONCE for the full old tuple.
assumptions: The generator does not accept an arbitrary preexisting X. Approximate joint output is not an unchanged exact K0 contract: its proved variant carries eta+2epsilon on acceptance outside both guard bad events. Old missing guards cannot be invented.
costs: One forward P call,n+2 fresh bits in identity/P; at most2(m-1) selected primitive calls in commuting cover plus all acquisition/verification/search, alignment, source/equality, bits/caps and current target observations.
contract.units: epsilon_bar is average known-code alignment defect, joint TV<=2epsilon_bar; eta is the accepted actual aggregate source-pair defect. Counts are forward/code/source calls, not physical latency.
contract.obstruction: A hard conditional inverse for a supplied witness does not rule out a usable active joint experiment. The actual source-free forward cover and guard law must be established.

body: P(U) is uniform and the sampled U is its mathematical inverse already in hand, so independent tags are conditionally independent over every native h-preimage. The algorithm never inverts an externally supplied challenge. For commuting branches, product Q and omit-one R_j provide actual forward words. A finite generic word compiler may fail/overrun and returns UNKNOWN. Known-code alignment guards do not replace proof that all branches/words are permutations. Couple actual endpoints to virtual inverse-defined endpoints; union of the two alignment failures bounds joint TV by2epsilon. The actual full-tuple collision defect is bounded by the sum of guarded per-source defects, so its one ideal-law transfer costs2epsilon once, not per source. Freeze the pair procedure and buy the actual old equality guards before expiry.
